component.name: CleanMyLinux
component.summary: Reclaim disk space and keep your system clean

description.p: CleanMyLinux is a native system-cleanup app inspired by CleanMyMac. A single Smart Scan finds reclaimable space across caches, package leftovers, large files and more, and cleans it with one click — safely.

ul.li: Smart Scan dashboard with a reclaimable-space gauge
System junk: caches, thumbnails, Trash, browser caches
Package cleanup: APT cache, orphans, old kernels, journal, snap, flatpak
Large & old file finder (recoverable via Trash)
App uninstaller and a live system monitor

description.p: No telemetry. Nothing is deleted without your confirmation.
Initial release: Smart Scan, System Junk, Package Cleanup, Large & Old Files, Uninstaller and System Monitor.
